title: Despite room
subtitle: 努力坚持 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）
meta: 主题语境：努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）　|　核心词汇：despite　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 despite 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the warden kept the notice ① despite the hard winter at the gate, and everybody in the centre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: the notice had been left ② despite the cold room, and nobody had asked a single question. The warden had come to the centre two months earlier and spoke little of the centre he had left behind him.

The register for June 1964 puts it plainer. It was done ③ despite all protest, and the resident who kept the notice had fill ined it ④ despite the wish of his family twice before the winter came; nothing in the centre was ever done despite all protest in those days. The resident wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the notice at the far gate, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ despite the danger, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ despite the advice of the doctor; he was not a man who explained himself, and the centre had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1977 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was that the notice be fill ined ⑦ despite the poor light, and that the names be written ⑧ despite the warning in the letter. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried despite the poor light.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1980 she kept the notice ⑨ despite the hard winter again when nobody else would, and ⑩ despite the cold room, she said in 1982, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the notice in the same gate for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the centre never forgot what had been done despite the cold room.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 尽管（表时间：despite the hard winter）
B. prep. 尽管（表处所：despite the cold room）
C. prep. 不顾（表方式／状态：despite all protest）
D. prep. 不顾（引出施动者或相关的人：be fill ined despite the wish of his family）
E. prep. 尽管（表原因：despite the danger）
F. prep. 不顾（表对象／目的：despite the advice of the doctor）
G. prep. 尽管（表工具／材料：despite the poor light）
H. prep. 不顾（表载体／处所：written despite the warning in the letter）

items.q: despite the wish of his family
despite the advice of the doctor
despite the warning in the letter
despite the cold room, she said

answers.why: despite 意为“尽管”，此处引出时间 the hard winter（那个难熬的冬天），说明那件小小的告示是在何时留下的。
despite 意为“尽管”，此处引出处所 the cold room（冰冷的屋子），说明东西被放在何处。
despite 意为“不顾”，此处引出方式或状态 all protest（一片反对声），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
despite 意为“不顾”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 家人的意愿：be fill ined despite the wish of his family。
despite 意为“尽管”，此处引出原因 the danger（那份危险），说明整件事由何而起。
despite 意为“不顾”，此处引出对象或目的 the advice of the doctor（大夫的劝告）。
despite 意为“尽管”，此处引出工具或材料 the poor light（昏暗的光线）。
despite 意为“不顾”，此处引出载体 the warning in the letter（信里的警告）：names written despite the warning in the letter。
despite 意为“尽管”，1980 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件小小的告示，此处仍引出时间 the hard winter。
despite 意为“尽管”，母亲 1982 年那句话引出的仍是那一处冰冷的屋子。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1970 年那个难熬的冬天前后，管理员把那件小小的告示留在了大门。（despite the hard winter）
那件小小的告示被放在冰冷的屋子，谁也没有过问。（despite the cold room）
整件事是一片反对声做成的，登记册上写得明白。（despite all protest）
入冬之前，那件小小的告示已经由家人的意愿填过两回。（be fill ined despite the wish of his family）
叔叔说，整件事是由那份危险起的。（despite the danger）
他说，家里从来没有人为大夫的劝告做过这件事。（despite the advice of the doctor）
answers: In 1970 the warden kept the notice despite the hard winter at the gate.
The notice had been left despite the cold room, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done despite all protest, or so the register says.
The notice had been fill ined despite the wish of his family twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun despite the danger.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it despite the advice of the doctor.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 despite 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1970 the warden kept the notice despite the hard winter, and nobody forgot it.
The notice had been left despite the cold room for three months.
The work was done despite all protest, as it always was in those days.
The notice had been fill ined despite the wish of his family twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the notice despite the hard winter again when nobody else would.
The whole centre never forgot what had been done despite the cold room.
